p: bondage: Where they were in most cruel slavery.
eaten: To signify that they did not have time to leaven their bread.
Abib: Containing part of March and part of April, when corn began to ripen in that country.
seventh day shall be a feast: Both the seventh and the first day were holy, as in Ex 12:16.
in that day: When you celebrate the feast of unleavened bread.
upon thine hand: You will constantly remember it, as you would of a thing that is in your hand, or before your eyes.
ass thou shalt redeem with a: This is also understood about the horse and other beasts which were not offered in sacrifice.
redeem: By offering a clean beast in sacrifice; Le 12:6.
see war: Which the Philistines would have made against them by blocking their passage.
harnessed out of the land of: That is, not secretly but openly and as the word signifies, set in order by five and five.
cloud: To defend them from the heat of the sun.
